title: Total-limit realization of an open-unit-normalized reverse refinement
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l different from its characteristic, simultaneous operations o and prescribed realization data R [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. Let f:X→Y be separated finite type between finite-type D.k-schemes, with no absolute separatedness assumed. Let K be a finite-Tor constructible integral input. Assume every one of the eighteen words in every composable binary compactification-refinement diagram is in its stated domain [def-sf-refinement-diagram-words]. For compactifications c,d and v:c→d, let e:J_d K ≅ S_v J_c K be an actual integral isomorphism whose open-adjunction transpose, followed by the prescribed refinementRestriction [def-sf-integral-refinement-normalization-data], is the open unit. Write s_v:B_d R(K)→B_c R(K) for completedShriekRefinement [def-sf-completed-shriek-refinement-maps] and b_v=S_{p_d}(e) followed by the forward proper compositor. For any outside proper/open context q [def-sf-normalized-refinement-context-data] for which both substituted endpoints are geometric and in their domains, their outside-coordinate realization isomorphisms satisfy L(q_system(s_v)) followed by a_{q,c} = a_{q,d} followed by q_integral(b_v). This is a comparison of a single reverse system arrow with its prescribed integral mate, before finite evaluation; it asserts no identity/composition law and involves no auxiliary F_c, rho, or r_c.

proof.text: Expand the reverse refinement into inverse identity proper unitor, intrinsic proper/open mate for (j_c,1_X,v,j_d), and proper compositor. Use the generator reduction equation and the realization normalization against the actual reconstruction counit to compare the localized integral mate, including its proper compositor. The eighteen-word hypotheses retain every proper/open intermediate required for these squares.

Under the open adjunction, compose the transpose of the realized mate with the canonical pullback-composition/proper-counit restriction. The clopen normalization gives the open unit, exactly the assumed transpose of e. Cancel the restriction isomorphism on this input and use injectivity of homEquiv to identify the actual arrows. This also applies for identity refinements, empty opens and zero input.

Induct on the outside context. The hole is the preceding comparison. A proper factor uses naturality of the proper realization and its recursive push formula. An open factor uses the recursive shriek formula and naturality of the normalized open realization: cancel its invertible reconstruction unit and counit in the normalization equation. The evaluationIso associators give exactly the displayed outside coordinates. No finite-evaluation equality detection is used.

theorem integralRefinementTransposeRealization
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (o : Operations l E) (R : Realizations l E D o)
    {X Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.left] [QuasiCompact f.left]
    (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l E X.left)
    (hDiagram : ∀ (a : Fin 3 → Compactification f.left)
      (v : (a 0).Refinement (a 1)) (w : (a 1).Refinement (a 2)) (i : Fin 18),
      (refinementDiagramWords f a v w (fun _ ↦ inferInstance) i).2.domain l E o
        (fun _ ↦ K.obj))
    (c d : Compactification f.left) (v : c.Refinement d)
    (e : (ringedOpen l E d.i).obj K.obj ≅
      (ringedPush l E v.hom).obj ((ringedOpen l E c.i).obj K.obj))
    (he : (ringedOpenAdj l E d.i).homEquiv _ _ e.hom ≫
      PurCompactSupport.refinementRestriction (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) v
        (PurCompactSupport.completedPull_comp l E c.i v.hom) K.obj =
      (ringedOpenAdj l E c.i).unit.app K.obj)
    {W : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k))}
    (q : NormalizedRefinementContext _ Y W)
    (gc : (q.plug (normalizedRefinementWord f c)).geometric)
    (gd : (q.plug (normalizedRefinementWord f d)).geometric)
    (hc : (q.plug (normalizedRefinementWord f c)).domain l E o (fun _ ↦ K.obj))
    (hd : (q.plug (normalizedRefinementWord f d)).domain l E o (fun _ ↦ K.obj)) :
    (coefficientSequenceLimit l E W.left).map
        ((q.evaluate (systemInterpretation l E o)).map
          ((completedShriekRefinement l E R v).app
            ((calculus l E X.left).reduction.obj K.obj))) ≫
      (q.realization l E R (normalizedRefinementWord f c) gc (fun _ ↦ K.obj) hc).hom =
    (q.realization l E R (normalizedRefinementWord f d) gd (fun _ ↦ K.obj) hd).hom ≫
      (q.evaluate (integralInterpretation l E)).map
        ((ringedPush l E d.g).map e.hom ≫
          (ringedPushComp l E v.hom d.g ≪≫
            eqToIso (congrArg (ringedPush l E) v.hom_g)).hom.app
              ((ringedOpen l E c.i).obj K.obj))
